event_ignition.missing_or_branches: A passing observed branch detects; otherwise any missing branch is INSUFFICIENT_DATA, never zero. Event research is independent.

second_leg.reclaim_condition: FINAL_CLOSE_AT_OR_ABOVE_IMPULSE_HIGH; no pullback high above impulse high
second_leg.window_selection: FIXED_LATEST_24_COMPLETED_BARS; no search for the best past segmentation

notes: These prospective hypotheses were specified before running the new cohort. Retrospective winners do not establish an edge.
All bars, benchmark bars and baseline windows must be observed, completed, matched in time and available by cutoff. No future bars or backdated event knowledge.
Comparable volume uses the frozen v1 validator: median of 10 to 20 unique prior same-clock/session/feed/unit intervals.
A stale completed close is SIGNAL_BAR_REFERENCE only, never an executable/detection-price scoring baseline.
This evaluator does not schedule, deliver notifications, place orders or create an ENTRY-ELIGIBLE decision.
